shared: Use one shared Skill library and the existing two-stage router. Match available Skills first; search metadata only when needed; read only the selected current-stage owner. Keep user scope, tools, permissions and acceptance criteria unchanged. Do not run model evaluations or infer model identity from prose.

notes.Astra: Use clear outcomes and completion criteria; avoid duplicate coaching, broad mandatory prereading and unnecessary approval checkpoints.
notes.Sol: Use the shared workflow; balance task complexity and time without adding a mandatory per-Skill recipe.
notes.Terra: Use observed state and supported tools for visual or computer tasks; keep edits scoped and writing concise. Preserve the user's tool route.
notes.Luna: Keep the current work unit focused, with explicit inputs, outputs and a short set of necessary steps; do not split or shrink the user's overall objective.
